title: A great new line of cookware from Calphalon, looks like I am going to be buying a whole new set!
text: A great new line of cookware from Calphalon, looks like I am going to be buying a whole new set!. I love Calphalon and have used their pots and pans exclusively over the past 10+ years. Quality products, durable and a great non-stick surface, Calphalon makes quality products that every chef loves to use. I was ecstatic to see this new space saving variety and, ugh, now I am hooked and will have to buy more of this line. I love the way this fits in my cabinet compactly and I will have to test how the matching set nests together to save space. I am tough on my cookware and use gas exclusively in my kitchen and Calphalon stand up to regular use and washes clean effortlessly. No complaints except now that I have used this 5 qt saute pan I will now have to invest and purchase the others in the line.

product_metadata.title: Calphalon Premier Space-Saving Hard-Anodized Nonstick 5-Quart Saute Pan with Lid
features: Stacks neatly and nests in any order, saving up to 30% more space
Built to last, with MineralShield nonstick technology that’s 5x more durable than before (vs. previous generation of Calphalon Classic)
Metal-utensil-safe with a long-lasting, 3-layer nonstick interior
Oven-safe up to 450 degrees F, so you can easily go from stovetop to oven
Compatible with most stovetops, including gas, electric, and glass
description: Featuring MineralShield nonstick technology, Calphalon Premier Space-Saving Hard-Anodized Nonstick Cookware is now 5x more durable than before when compared to the previous generation of Calphalon Classic. This nonstick saute pan delivers long-lasting performance for effortless food release, so you can cook with confidence and serve even the most delicate food with ease. This space-saving line also securely stacks to save 30% more space than its non-stacking counterparts. Thanks to their unique design and flat glass covers, the pots and pans stack and nest in any order when stored on other items of the same diameter. A 3-layer nonstick interior is made with some of the Earth's hardest minerals to withstand metal utensils and everyday use and the hard-anodized exterior is dishwasher-safe for easy cleanup. They are oven-safe up to 450 degrees F, able to go from the stovetop into the oven for heating and cooking versatility. Elevate your cooking experience with Calphalon Premier, and enjoy exceptional performance with endless possibilities.

details.Special Feature: Gas Stovetop Compatible, Electric Stovetop Compatible
